query: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 query.term=(<target terms>) AND (antibody-drug conjugate OR ADC), countTotal
note: Counts are ClinicalTrials.gov studies whose text mentions an antibody-drug conjugate together with the target's terms; for broad markers (HER2, EGFR, PSMA...) that includes trials that only enrol marker-positive patients, so those are flagged ambiguous and not used to rank.
